solitaire.diff_all: Solitaire. Select difficulty. Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert.
solitaire.diff_easy_only: Solitaire. Select difficulty. Only Easy is unlocked. Win games to unlock harder difficulties.
solitaire.rule_1: Matching cards can be stacked and can then be moved together.
solitaire.rule_2: When four matching cards are united on the tableau they will collapse into a locked stack. This will also unlock a free cell if one is available.
solitaire.rule_3: Free cells can store a single card of any type. Four matching cards can also be united in a free cell to collapse them into a locked stack.
solitaire.rule_4: To win the game, collapse all ten types of cards into ten locked stacks.
